evidence: Two stages, both in code. Hysteresis gate: simulation/forecast_schedule.py:74 default --hysteresis-min 3; implemented as rolling MAX over trailing window (:139-144, docstring :12 'hysteresis = rolling max of desired over the trailing H minutes'). Because it is a rolling max, scale-up raises the held value the same bin (immediate up) while the held value only drops after the entire trailing 3-minute window has dropped -> scale-DOWN fires only after 3 min sustained low load. Immediate actuation: simulation/live51/worker_manager.py:18-21 'a scale-down takes effect immediately (cancel pending spawns first, then SIGTERM newest)', vs scale-up delayed by --spawn-delay cold-start lead. Matches baselines.tex:62 exactly.
